title: When discipline keeps thinning out as a steady practice
issueStatement: Good intention is present, but the pattern cannot hold. The deeper need is not inspiration alone, but a repeatable way to keep returning.
centralInsight: Guru places discipline inside remembrance, restraint, and inner victory instead of image management. The line becomes durable when it is practiced, not merely admired.
practicalReflection: The hardest field is the inner field. Win there first. Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer.
actionPrompt: Make the next faithful repetition smaller and truer. Repeat what you can actually keep.
